msg: My advice, using both hands keep left ring finger on the "s" key and your left ring finger on the "k" key. Use your thumbs of both hands to press the spacebar key - that way you are ready for each round without having to look where the keys are The tall skinny brown gnome seemed to give me more mushrooms but that could just be luck of the draw.I tried to keep a note in my head of which gnome gave the most mushrooms in each round and I stuck with them until the mushrooms decreased - I then switched to the other gnome.Hope this makes sense and good luck friend!
